title: Export proceeds and customs allocation calendar
topic: export shipment certificate pooled capacity customs allocation deadlines
content: The first shipment has an early cash-and-reporting settlement deadline. Its actual cash settlement starts a later customs allocation for the second shipment, after allocation_delay minutes. The pending shipment publishes a reportable range; the result publishes actual basis in the original lot. The second declaration must use that actual value. Declaration documents may issue after cash settlement; each lot’s document_deadline applies to actual delivery. Adjustment-only proceeds stay ordinary, and historical withdrawals acquire no new rights. Certificate fees, product fees and every new lot principal share the original source account.

provenance.scope: Fictional certificate allocation and shipment timing; no tax refund guarantee.
